import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static class SimpleEdge {
        int trg;
        SimpleEdge() {}
        SimpleEdge(int trg) { this.trg = trg; }
    }

    static class WeightedEdge<T> {
        int trg;
        T weight;
        WeightedEdge() {}
        WeightedEdge(int trg, T weight) { this.trg = trg; this.weight = weight; }
    }

    static class GraphBase<TE> {
        List<Node<TE>> nodes;

        public GraphBase(int size) {
            nodes = new ArrayList<>(size);
            for (int i = 0; i < size; i++) {
                nodes.add(new Node<>());
            }
        }

        public int size() {
            return nodes.size();
        }

        public Node<TE> getNode(int id) {
            return nodes.get(id);
        }
    }

    static class Node<TE> {
        List<TE> edges = new ArrayList<>();
    }

    static class UGGraph extends GraphBase<SimpleEdge> {
        public UGGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        public void add1(int a, int b) {
            nodes.get(a).edges.add(new SimpleEdge(b));
        }

        public void add2(int a, int b) {
            add1(a, b);
            add1(b, a);
        }
    }

    static class WGraph<T> extends GraphBase<WeightedEdge<T>> {
        public WGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        public void add1(int a, int b, T weight) {
            nodes.get(a).edges.add(new WeightedEdge<>(b, weight));
        }

        public void add2(int a, int b, T weight) {
            add1(a, b, weight);
            add1(b, a, weight);
        }
    }

    static class MCMFEdge<T> {
        int trg;
        T cost;
        T adjcost;
        T flow;
        T cap;
        int dual;

        public MCMFEdge(int trg, T cost, T cap, int dual) {
            this.trg = trg;
            this.cost = cost;
            this.adjcost = cost;
            this.flow = null;
            this.cap = cap;
            this.dual = dual;
        }
    }

    static class MCMFGraph<T> extends GraphBase<MCMFEdge<T>> {
        public MCMFGraph(int size) {
            super(size);
        }

        class PQItem implements Comparable<PQItem> {
            int trg;
            T prio;

            public PQItem(int trg, T prio) {
                this.trg = trg;
                this.prio = prio;
            }

            @Override
            public int compareTo(PQItem o) {
                // Assuming T is comparable
                return ((Comparable<T>) this.prio).compareTo(o.prio);
            }
        }

        public Pair<T, T> augment(int source, int sink, T big, Comparator<T> cmp) {
            int N = size();
            T[] upby = (T[]) new Object[N];
            T[] prio = (T[]) new Object[N];
            int[] preve = new int[N];

            Arrays.fill(prio, big);
            Arrays.fill(preve, -1);
            PriorityQueue<PQItem> q = new PriorityQueue<>();

            prio[source] = (T) new Integer(0);
            upby[source] = big;
            q.add(new PQItem(source, (T) new Integer(0)));

            while (!q.isEmpty()) {
                PQItem curItem = q.poll();
                int cur = curItem.trg;
                T p = curItem.prio;
                if (!p.equals(prio[cur]))
                    continue;
                List<MCMFEdge<T>> edges = nodes.get(cur).edges;
                for (int i = 0; i < edges.size(); i++) {
                    MCMFEdge<T> e = edges.get(i);
                    T p2 = (T) new Integer(0);
                    p2 = (T) new Integer(((Comparable<T>) p).compareTo(e.adjcost));
                    if (((Comparable<T>) e.flow).compareTo(e.cap) < 0 && ((Comparable<T>) p2).compareTo(prio[e.trg]) < 0) {
                        prio[e.trg] = p2;
                        preve[e.trg] = e.dual;
                        T minVal = (T) new Integer(0);
                        minVal = (T) new Integer(Math.min(((Comparable<T>) e.cap).compareTo(e.flow), ((Comparable<T>) upby[cur]).compareTo((T) new Integer(0))));
                        upby[e.trg] = minVal;
                        q.add(new PQItem(e.trg, p2));
                    }
                }
            }

            T up = upby[sink];
            T upcost = (T) new Integer(0);
            if (!up.equals((T) new Integer(0))) {
                int cur = sink;
                while (cur != source) {
                    MCMFEdge<T> ed = nodes.get(cur).edges.get(preve[cur]);
                    MCMFEdge<T> e = nodes.get(ed.trg).edges.get(ed.dual);
                    e.flow = (T) new Integer(((Integer) e.flow) + ((Integer) up));
                    upcost = (T) new Integer(((Integer) upcost) + ((Integer) e.cost) * ((Integer) up));
                    ed.flow = (T) new Integer(((Integer) ed.flow) - ((Integer) up));
                    cur = ed.trg;
                }
                for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
                    List<MCMFEdge<T>> edges = nodes.get(i).edges;
                    for (int j = 0; j < edges.size(); j++) {
                        MCMFEdge<T> e = edges.get(j);
                        e.adjcost = (T) new Integer(((Integer) e.adjcost) + ((Integer) prio[i]) - ((Integer) prio[e.trg]));
                    }
                }
            }
            return new Pair<>(up, upcost);
        }

        public Pair<T, T> make_flow(int source, int sink, T big, Comparator<T> cmp) {
            for (Node<MCMFEdge<T>> node : nodes) {
                for (MCMFEdge<T> e : node.edges) {
                    e.flow = (T) new Integer(0);
                    e.adjcost = e.cost;
                }
            }
            T flow = (T) new Integer(0);
            T cost = (T) new Integer(0);
            Pair<T, T> up;
            while (true) {
                up = augment(source, sink, big, cmp);
                if (((Integer) up.first).equals(0))
                    break;
                flow = (T) new Integer(((Integer) flow) + ((Integer) up.first));
                cost = (T) new Integer(((Integer) cost) + ((Integer) up.second));
            }
            return new Pair<>(flow, cost);
        }
    }

    static class Pair<U, V> {
        public U first;
        public V second;
        public Pair(U first, V second) {
            this.first = first;
            this.second = second;
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        StringTokenizer st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        int N = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int M = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int K = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int C = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());
        int D = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken());

        int[] a = new int[K];
        int[] starts = new int[N];
        st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < K; i++) {
            a[i] = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            starts[a[i]]++;
        }

        int maxT = K + N + 1;
        int V = (maxT + 1) * N + 2;
        int src = V - 2;
        int sink = V - 1;
        MCMFGraph<Integer> g = new MCMFGraph<>(V);

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            if (starts[i] > 0) {
                g.nodes.get(src).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>(i, 0, starts[i], 0));
            }
        }

        for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; t++) {
            g.nodes.get(t * N).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>(sink, 0, K, 0));
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < N; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t <= maxT; t++) {
                g.nodes.get(t * N + i).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>( (t + 1) * N + i, C, K, 0));
            }
        }

        for (int i = 0; i < M; i++) {
            st = new StringTokenizer(br.readLine());
            int u = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            int v = Integer.parseInt(st.nextToken()) - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < maxT; t++) {
                g.nodes.get(t * N + u).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>( (t + 1) * N + v, C + (2 * 0 + 1) * D, 1, 0));
                g.nodes.get(t * N + v).edges.add(new MCMFEdge<>( (t + 1) * N + u, C + (2 * 0 + 1) * D, 1, 0));
            }
        }

        Pair<Integer, Integer> fc = g.make_flow(src, sink, Integer.MAX_VALUE, Comparator.naturalOrder());
        if (!fc.first.equals(K)) {
            throw new RuntimeException("Flow not equal to K");
        }
        System.out.println(fc.second);
    }
}
